invariants: every active metric resolves to exactly one FormulaDefinition
all inputs and available outputs are canonical DecimalString values
all arithmetic uses decimal.js v10+ with arbitrary precision and ROUND_HALF_EVEN
persisted computed decimals are rounded to scale 12 before canonical serialization; trailing zeros are removed
zero is serialized only as 0; -0 and exponential notation are forbidden
evaluation follows evaluationPrecedence exactly and returns the first applicable reasonCode
local clock, locale, timezone and binary floating point never influence formula output or fingerprints
unavailable states never persist a fabricated numeric value
